reports.title: FRANKLIN ELECTRIC REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is raising its guidance for full year 2026 net sales to be in the range of $2.23 billion to $2.30 billion and full year 2026 Adjusted Diluted EPS to be in the range of $4.62 to $4.82.
